title: Distruptive-DataHack
summary: A hackathon notebook project that experiments with tabular synthetic data generation and quality evaluation on a dataset. The core work fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer on the data, defines metadata via SingleTableMetadata, and evaluates results with evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic, making SDV's sdv.single_table and sdv.evaluation modules run directly to produce and assess synthetic data.
needs: Domain/industry of the hackathon dataset is not specified in the truncated README; defaulted to cross_industry.
